items.prompt: Starting from total=10000 in units of 10^-4, an otherwise valid S record has quantity 2 and price 0.0001. What total follows acceptance?

options.why: This subtracts the sell product. The task counts positive notional for both B and S, not signed position.
A valid sell is included, not ignored. Its small price still contributes two exact scale units.
Price is one scale unit and quantity is two, so the positive product adds two units.
This uses a cent scale instead of the declared 10^-4 scale for the accepted product.
